reviewed_by: Claude: goal supervisor notes and mid-turn addenda, focused backend, component and mocked browser selection
reason: Running goals gain bounded supervisor notes (ChatGoal.supervisor_notes, 4,000 characters each, at most 50, a 51st refused) with POST/DELETE /chat/sessions/{id}/goal/notes on control capacity, a guidance_revision that only objective, criteria, plan and note changes bump, and a bounded change log. A running provider goal turn records the guidance revision it was prepared with and, before each routing call, receives what changed once as a Core-added goal.read result (new read-only goal.read tool on provider goal turns); a running harness turn is steered; Grok and idle goals read the change at the next turn. Notes ride on the per-turn goal progress block, never the cached instructions. Butler gets nebula.work.add_goal_note and a bounded goal view. The goal panel adds an Add note form, a Supervisor notes list with remove, and a delivery status line. Selected: the new regression file (note append/cap/render/paging, guidance-change recording, native once-only mid-turn delivery, harness steer and Grok fallback, control lane), goal lifecycle, Butler work tools, goal tool budgets, Core delivery steps, harness goals, recovery-control routes, runtime delivery, turn bookkeeping, the runtime manifest (entity field digest) and the Playwright manifest; the goal panel and destination component tests; the new mocked goal-notes browser journey and the goal panel revision race in desktop and mobile Chromium/WebKit.
exclusions: tests/v3/test_butler_capabilities.py and tests/v3/test_butler_workflow_registry.py are excluded because each already fails one test on origin/main (UPDATE_GOAL_SCHEMA lacks active_plan_index; useProjectViewLease calls are unreviewed); their other tests passed locally with this change. Real-Core Playwright (real-core.spec.ts) is not selected: the real-Core journey was exercised on a disposable LAN Core instead. No native change. No full-suite approval.
